profile.name: Aditya Kulkarni

projects.title: Cycle Time Reduction on a Gear Machining Line
projects.description: Final-year project with an auto-components plant. Mapped the gear machining line with a value stream map, ran time studies at each station and found the hobbing station was the bottleneck. Rebalanced the line, applied SMED to cut changeover time, and validated the new layout in a FlexSim simulation before a trial run, where cycle time fell from 6.2 to 4.8 minutes per part.

profile.experience: Eight-week internship in the production planning department of an auto-components manufacturer.
